mechanics.title: Data-driven configurators
mechanics.description: Datapacks define a "dispenser_configurator" listing items/tags and targets (five item-use methods) that control how dispensers use them. Known issue: the ITEM_USE target does not work for every item.

vanilla_changes.change: Dispensers can use additional items per the default datapack; the exact list is not in the facts (see mod wiki).

commands_and_keybinds: /datapack disable <default dispenser configurators pack> turns off the defaults
editor_notes: Default configurator list not extracted; check the mod wiki or in-game. Datapack id for /datapack disable should be confirmed.
name: Dispenser Configurator
summary: Data-driven mod that lets dispensers use many more items. A bundled "Default Dispenser Configurators" datapack gives several items dispenser behaviors; it can be disabled with /datapack disable.
